The Selected model is slain and a new Da Red Gobbo model is placed within 1” of the slain model before it is removed from play. The new Da Red Gobbo may be elected to be Attached to a nearby eligible unit.

sharedRules.name: Breaking Heads
sharedRules.description: When an Ork unit with this special rule or any attached special rule would fail a Pinning or Panic test, you can inflict D3 wounds on the unit that failed the test. Saves may be taken against these wounds as normal (Armour & Invulnerable saves only). The unit is then considered to have passed the test.

sharedRules.name: Vehicle Mob
sharedRules.description: Units with this special rule that include more than 1 model must be deployed within 3” of each other at the beginning of the game during the Deployment step and are deployed as 1 unit. After Deployment, each model in Mob counts as its own individual unit.

sharedRules.name: Beast Snagga
sharedRules.description: Ork units in your army with this special rule have the Monster Hunter and Preferred Enemy (Beast) special rules.

sharedRules.name: Grot Mob
sharedRules.description: Units with this special rule never count for Victory Points when slain or wrecked.

sharedRules.name: Bubble
sharedRules.description: When rolling to wound or penetrate with this weapon, this weapons Strength (S) characteristic is equal to the Targets Strength (S) characteristic. This Weapons AP is equal to the targets Armour Save.

sharedRules.name: Trakta Beam
sharedRules.description: Instead of rolling to hit, after you have selected a target for this weapon, you may move that target unit anywhere on the board up to the target units Initiative (I) characteristic. After completing this move, the target must make a Dangerous Terrain test. Aircraft type units targeted by this weapon take an automatic Penetrating hit. The Penetrating hit is  resolved with +2 to the dice roll on the vehicle damage chart.

sharedRules.name: Tellyported
sharedRules.description: When a unit is hit by this weapon, after resolving all wounds, the unit is removed from the board and placed back down anywhere on the board, more than 3” away from any enemy models.

sharedRules.name: Armed to da Teef
sharedRules.description: All Bad Moons Infantry, Jetbike, Cavlary & Bike units gain the Arcing (6+) special rule in the Shooting Phase on all Shooting weapons they are equipped with while targeting an enemy within 12”.

sharedRules.name: Smart Boyz
sharedRules.description: ll Blood Axe Infantry, Jetbike, Cavlary & Bike units in your army gain the Skirmisher special rule.

sharedRules.name: Diz is ours! Zog off!
sharedRules.description: If a Death Skullz is contesting an objective. It may not make any Retreat moves. If the unit would Panic while within 6” of an Objective marker, it instead does not, and is Pinned instead.

sharedRules.name: Stunt Driva’s!

sharedRules.name: Savage Ferocity

rules.description: Friendly Ork units which can draw line of sight to a model with this Warlord Trait may re-roll Pinning and Panic tests.

rules.name: Kunnin But Brutal
rules.description: The Warlord and any attached unit gains either the Scout or Outflank special rule. This is selected when mustering your army.

rules.description: The Warlord gains the Rage and Zealot special rules.

rules.name: Da Jump (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit are immediately moved 24” from their current location. The units count as having conducted a whatever type of move they conducted in the previous Movement Phase.

rules.name: Warpath (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain +1 to their Attacks (A) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: I Can Fix That! (Machine Rite)
rules.description:
When this Rite is performed successfully, select one of the
following effects:
• Select 1 Walker or Automata unit either within 3” or attached to the unit that is performing this rite. The target unit Heals 1 wound.
• Select 1 Vehicle, Aircraft, Knight or Fortification either within 3”, attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon. Select 1 weapon that target unit is equipped with that has been destroyed. The chosen weapon is no longer destroyed.
• Select 1 Vehicle or Knight either within 3”, attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon that is immobilized. That unit is no longer immobilized. If the unit has the Super Heavy (x) special rule and was Limping, it is no longer considered to be Limping.

rules.name: Turbo Charge! (Machine Rite)
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, the unit performing this Rite, a Vehicle, Titan, Knight, Aircraft, or Walker unit within 3” of the unit performing this Rite or a unit that unit performing unit is embarked upon may immediately make a Normal Move. However, the selected unit and any embarked unit may not Shoot in the Shooting Phase or Charge in the Charge Phase.

rules.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka! (Machine Rite)
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, the unit performing this Rite, a Vehicle, Titan, Knight, Aircraft, or Walker unit within 3” of the unit performing this Rite or a unit that unit performing unit is embarked upon. The target unit may select 1 weapon it is equipped with and make a second Shooting Attack with it this Phase.

rules.name: Smog It! (Machine Rite)
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, the unit performing this Rite, a Vehicle, Titan, Knight, Aircraft, or Walker unit within 3” of the unit performing this Rite or a unit that unit performing unit is embarked upon. The target unit gains the benefit of Heavy Cover until the stat of your next Shooting Phase.
